Name: Ria's Storage Network
Author: Solariaze
Description:
[color=#e4e4e7][size=4]This mod is directly inspired by [url=https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/refined-storage]Refined Storage[/url] of Minecraft and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2563309347]Magic Storage[/url] of Terraria. [/size][/color]
[youtube]9Ehaf7MDttQ[/youtube]

[color=#ff7700][size=4][b]Features[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Combine chests (and other storage items) into a storage network by placing them next to a Storage Core.[/*]
[*]Access all your items in one unified vault, searchable and sortable by name, amount and category.[/*]
[*]Multiple storage tiers starting from Wood Cache that can hold 64 items up to the max tier Radioactive Cache that can hold 1024 items.[/*]
[*]A chest connected to the Storage Core ignores its own slots. A Chest and a Big Chest with the same Cache hold the same amount.[/*]
[*]Choose which chests to enable or disable. Disabled chests moves its items to the other enabled chest.[/*]
[*]Placed chests next to a Storage Core cannot be opened. Chests won't be removed if it currently has cache in it. Cache won't be removed if the chests currently holds items.[/*]
[*]Craft your items directly in the storage network (crafted items will be placed in your inventory).[/*]
[/list][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]Compatible with
[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]All GUI mods (thanks to StardewUI)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10384]Convenient Storage[/url] (Auto Stash)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7431]Expanded Storage[/url] (and all packs added by it)[/*]
[/list][color=#ff00ff][size=4][b]Planned Features[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Make Better Crafting work on my GUI (I'll look into it if it's possible on my side).[/*]
[*]Progression-based system. Currently all recipes are unlocked by default, maybe in the future I'll lock them behind a skill or heart event/s to fit them right in the game, with proper vanilla-friendly lore. I will add config to unlock them by default.[/*]
[*]Network transmitter and network receiver, letting players connect multiple remote storage cores from different locations to form one singular network (directly inspired from Refined Storage).[/*]
[*]Access the Storage Core through a wireless grid (or wireless crafting grid) when a wireless transmitter is set up in the Storage Core (directly inspired from Refined Storage).[/*]
[*]Possible integrations with other mods (e.g Resource Storage, Tool Pouch).[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Pathoschild]Pathoschild [/url]for [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/mushymato/mods]mushymato [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/focustense/mods]focustense [/url]for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43861]StardewUI[/url][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Mods Featured in Screenshots[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7807]6480's Storage Variety[/url][/*]
[/list]I finally get to publish a C# mod after trying to learn C# for 2 years. Hoping this mod helps a lot of players in managing their items.
